Instructions for Use
Device description: The Nova Spinal System is a spinal fixation system. It is available in lengths from 15 mm to 38 mm.
Warnings: For single use only. Do not resterilize. Store at 15 °C to 30 °C.
Refer to the surgical technique guide for implantation instructions.

MRI Information
MR Conditional (1.5 and 3.0 Tesla): SFG ≤ 30 T/m (3,000 G/cm); maximum B1+rms of 1.7 µT; whole body SAR not to exceed 4 W/kg; Normal Operating Mode or First Level Controlled Operating Mode; Scan for up to 30 minutes; Wait 5 minutes before the next imaging session; Any transmit coil may be used.
RF heating was evaluated using a body coil at 64 MHz and 128 MHz in a gel phantom.
Testing used a maximum gradient amplitude of 40 mT/m.
